cohort: Singleton pregnant women with normal pre-pregnancy BMI or obese (BMI >= 30) who delivered newborns between 28-42 weeks of gestation.
finding: Obese pregnant women have an increased risk of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, failed induction of labor, cesarean delivery, and large for gestational age newborns.
mod_finding: Obese women had a significantly increased risk of labor induction, failed induction of labor, and cesarean delivery.
